source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fixed Thunderbird testCheckboxes helper calls is with actual checked, expected checked, wantedValue and then the intended message. The separately pinned Gecko browser-test harness declares is(a,b,name), so wantedValue occupies the message argument and the fourth string is ignored. That string also omits not for the unchecked expectation. This is a static caller/signature and expected-behavior diagnostic defect, distinct from merely omitting should. Check arity and the actual Boolean expectation before copying this helper. No test was run; the Gecko signature is identified separately and is not claimed to be the fixed comm parent.
title: The checkbox preference helper loses its message through an extra argument
